summary: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a Subscription Agreement for Class B Shares with Beverly Holding Limited, a company wholly owned by CEO Muchun Zhu. The subscriber agreed to buy 650,000 Class B shares at $3.00 per share, total $1.95 million. The Audit Committee approved the issuance. Closing requires shareholder approvals: increasing authorized capital to $250M (100B shares), changing Class B voting rights from 30 to 100 votes per share, and adopting amended articles. This is a related-party capital raising with governance changes, not a transformative special situation, so category is 'Other'.
